filtersOrSort: implicitly scoped to the current user's own applications
reads.pagination: none — full list rendered, no infinite scroll or page controls

authContext.note: No explicit gate/session check (e.g. creatorGates()) appears in this screen's code. requiresAuth is inferred from the data being user-scoped (own applications, own reference numbers) — the page itself performs no auth check, relying entirely on route/layout-level protection outside this screen's scope.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: state === "loading" — the initial value on mount, and re-set at the top of load() on manual retry, before Promise.all([getApplication(id), getOtherApplications(id)]) resolves
getApplication(id).catch() rejects, OR the resolved application is null/undefined (id does not match any record) — renders ErrorState with an onRetry that re-runs load()
both getApplication(id) and getOtherApplications(id) resolve and application is non-null
application.rejection is truthy (per type comment, only ever set when application.status === "rejected")
application.amountPaid != null OR application.certificateExpectedBy is truthy
application.amountPaid is null/undefined AND application.certificateExpectedBy is falsy (e.g. the mentor 'pending' application in mock data, which is free and has no certificate)
others.length > 0 (i.e. the current user has at least one other application besides this one)
